attributes.action: Make University Free in England and Cut Student Loan Interest
attributes.additional_details: University fees and loan interest can discourage people from studying. I want free undergraduate tuition for eligible home students in England from 2026/27 or 2027/28 and reduced or zero student loan interest. This could encourage more people to train for jobs in the NHS, social care, teaching, engineering, construction and technology, helping develop home-grown skills and reduce reliance on overseas recruitment where suitable UK-trained workers are available.
attributes.background: Make university tuition free for eligible home students in England from 2026/27 or 2027/28, and remove student loan interest. Like eligible Scottish students, students in England deserve fair access to higher education. We are all British.
